name: FFS_QBI_CAPACITY_AREA
description: Stores parameters of capacity areas and sub-areas to be used in Quota and Capacity Management.

columns.name: AREA_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Unique identifies capacity area.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to ORGANIZATION_ID in FFS_ORGANIZATION. It is only populated for sub-areas.

columns.name: BUCKET_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to RESOURCE_ID in FFS_RESOURCE. Identifies of a bucket in the main resource tree to be used to place booked activities into.

columns.name: OPTIONS
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines related rules.

columns.name: SWITCH_TO_PLANS_DAYS
columns.description: Number of next days after which switch to plans.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: START_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The last part of time slot in percent where we do not suggest booking options.

columns.name: BOOKING_WITH_FORECAST_MIN_DAYS
columns.description: Earliest day for booking with forecasting which is defined by the number of days regarding today.

columns.name: BOOKING_WITH_FORECAST_MAX_DAYS
columns.description: Latest day for booking with forecasting which is defined by the number of days regarding today.
